audit.why: The chart lives in two places (full phases[N].side and content win[N]) and must agree. win[N] already holds the right verdict, so per the decided chart rule I move side alone to match it, and rewrite phases[0].why (the only row whose side is flipping to the enemy) to explain the real reason Bard wins Level 1: Cosmic Binding's wall-stun threat plus Meep poke before Rell has knockup range.

edits.before: Mounted speed governs the lane's first minutes — the charge threat zones before it lands.
edits.after: Cosmic Binding threatens a wall stun and Meeps chip you before your knockup range comes online.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Cosmic Binding is down 11s at rank 1 (7s by rank 5) — trade or engage inside that window before he reloads the stun.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: His Q is live at the wall — trading now hands him a free stun and lets his Meeps chip you.

edits.before: - Bard Cosmic Binding: matchup-defining — The wall-stun starts every Bard pick — never hug terrain near him. It writes your spacing rules. - E Full Tilt (remount speed) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Bard's Q Cosmic Binding (11/10/9/8/7s) is matchup-defining — the wall-stun writes your spacing; trade the moment it's down. - His E Magical Journey (22-16s) baits overextensions, not trades. - Your R (120/100/80s) opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
